description: Verify whether audio hits a delivery target (Spotify -14 LUFS / EBU broadcast -23 / podcast -16 / etc.). Returns pass/fail with per-metric deltas and a concrete ffmpeg loudnorm command to fix if failing. Presets: spotify, apple-music, youtube, tidal, amazon-music, podcast, tiktok, instagram, soundcloud, deezer, ebu-broadcast, atsc-broadcast; or target="custom" with lufs+tp. With an account key, a target you saved on your account also works: give its slug as target (not on the keyless trial). Audio source: a public https URL, or a local file path (`path`).

path.description: Path to a LOCAL audio file on this machine. It is read here and uploaded to the AudioLab API for measuring, so you do not need to host it publicly (files up to 4 MB go in the request body; larger ones, up to 150 MB, upload over a signed URL and are swept from storage within the hour). Provide exactly one of url or path.

target.description: Preset id (spotify, apple-music, youtube, tidal, amazon-music, podcast, tiktok, instagram, soundcloud, deezer, ebu-broadcast, atsc-broadcast), the slug of a target saved on your account (needs an account key), or "custom" with lufs and tp.

url.description: Public https URL to the audio file. Provide exactly one of url or path.

name: check_target
title: Check audio against a loudness target (Spotify, EBU, etc.)
